segments.text: Welcome back to GitHub awesome channel.
Today we're diving into 25 incredible self-hosted projects on GitHub that you can run yourself. Let's get started.
RefREF, the open-source referral and affiliate platform that lets you launch a referral program in minutes. Drop in a
tiny JS snippet and boom, accurate referral tracking across your whole product. Refre handles referral
attribution, personalized landing pages, and even automated nudges to keep people sharing. Creators get a referral portal to track their invites and rewards.
Affiliates get their own partner dashboard.
Vakuna, the fastto-do app built for people who actually get things done. You can organize your entire life into
projects and subjects. Keep everything neatly grouped and switch between list, gant, table, or full canbon, whatever
matches your brain today. Sharing a project, easy. Assign tasks, track progress, and collaborate without friction. And yes, it's self-hostable because your tasks are your business.
Swing Music, the self-hosted music player that feels like a cooler Spotify, but you bring your own tracks. You get daily mixes based on your listening
habits, automatic metadata cleanup, proper album versions, and smart related artists, so your collection finally
feels organized. Browse by folders, manage playlists, create collections, check your listening stats, and enjoy a
slick lyrics view while you vibe. Just run it, open your browser, and boom.
Domain Watchdog, your new companion in the hunt for the perfect domain name.
This app taps into our DAP to track every detail about a domain. Who owns it? When it changed hands, and its entire history from birth all the way to
expiry. Want a domain that's already taken? Domain Watchdog has your back. It monitors the domain in real time,
detects when it's deleted or released, and can even auto purchase it for you through your provider's API.
Glance, a customizable dashboard that brings all your feeds together in one gorgeous interface. If you've ever wanted a single place to view your RSS
feeds, subreddit posts, weather forecasts, server stats, and even your Docker container status, Glance has you covered. We're talking low memory usage
and a single binary under 20 megabytes that runs on almost any OS or architecture. Pages load in about a second, even with tons of widgets.
Booklor, your personal digital library that finally treats your books the way they deserve. Organize your entire collection with smart shelves, instant
filters, and metadata pulled automatically from Goodreads, Amazon, Google Books, and more. Drop any EPUB,
PDF, or comic into your Book Drop folder, and it just appears in your library. Add private notes, fetch community reviews, email books in one
click, all wrapped in a modern, mobile friendly UI.
Helix ML, the private Genai stack that lets you build AI agents without ever touching the cloud. Deploy in your own VPC or data center and keep your data
fully under control. Spin up AI agents with multi-step reasoning and tool orchestration. Connect APIs, rag
knowledge bases, and even vision tasks, all from a simple configuration.
Build contextaware agents that answer questions, automate workflows, or assist customers instantly.
Minor U, the tool that turns complex PDFs and documents into LLM ready markdown or JSON in seconds. Forget messy text, headers, footers, or garbled
layouts. Minor U cleans it all and preserves the structure you actually need. Extract tables, images, formulas, and even footnotes automatically.
Formulas converted to latattex, tables converted to HTML, scan PDFs. Minor use OCR handles nine languages with ease.
Zero, the open- source Gmail alternative that puts you in control. Self-host your email, integrate Gmail or Outlook, and finally, own your inbox. Privacy, check.
No tracking, no data selling your emails, your rules. AI check. Agents and LLMs help you manage, summarize, and
supercharge your messages. Unified inbox for all your accounts. Fully customizable interface and developer friendly for endless integrations.
Amicle, your open- source AI dictation and note-taking assistant. Dictate hands-free, transcribe meetings, and capture notes effortlessly, three times
faster than typing. Context aware and smart, Amle knows where you're dictating. Slack, email, social media, and formats it perfectly. Local first, privacy focused, and powered by Genai.
Drive, the open-source file platform that turns your documents into real collaborative assets. With Drive, your
team gets one secure, centralized place to store everything and access it from anywhere. [clears throat] Search is lightning fast, navigation is
clean, and your entire workspace stays organized without effort. Share files and collaborate with granular control that keeps your data safe and only in the right hands.
Flagsmith, the open- source feature flagging platform that gives you complete control over your releases.
Roll out new features behind feature flags and flip them on or off instantly.
No redeploys, no drama. Target beta testers, run AB or multivaried experiments and segment users however
you want. Building for web, mobile, or backend, Flagsmith has 15 SDKs, so you can plug it into any app in minutes.
Your app probably collects email addresses every day. But how many of them are fake, invalid, or straight up trash? Meet Email Filter. The
self-hosted privacy first email validation tool that keeps your database clean without sending your data to anyone else. Email filter runs entirely
on your own server. All handled locally inside a lightweight containerized API.
Hemig, the encrypted secret sharing tool that keeps your sensitive info out of chat logs, emails, and anyone's prying
eyes. With zero knowledge client side encryption, your secrets are locked with AES- 256GCM before they ever leave your
browser. The server, it never sees your data or your keys. Just type your secret, set an expiration or view limit.
Optionally, add a password and share the link. Once it's viewed or times up, poof, it self-destructs.
We the personal finance tracker built on one simple principle. What you get is what you have. No budgets, no
categories, no guilt, just a clean, principles first way to manage your money. If you hate budgeting, but still want real control, this is your tool.
Wiggio helps you track exactly what matters, your income, expenses, and savings without ever dipping into last month's stash. This isn't another
spreadsheet replacement. It's a full-blown finance platform.
High Events, the open-source event ticketing platform that finally puts organizers back in control. Whether you're running a nightclub event, a
workshop, a conference, or a full-blown festival, Hide Events lets you sell tickets online your way, self-hosted or
in the cloud. Create flexible ticket types: free, paid, donationbased, even tiered drops. Hide VIP tickets behind
promo codes, add merch or upgrades at checkout, and manage shared capacities so you never overbook.
Fit Track E, the self-hosted workout tracker for people who want full control of their fitness data. Just export your workouts from your watch or favorite
fitness app. Upload the GPX files and boom, Fit Tracky turns them into clean maps, stats, and visualizations you
actually want to see. Track speed, distance, and filter workouts across time, location, and sport. Speaking of sports, Fit Track supports 24 of them.
Everything from running, hiking, wind surfing, even halfike.
Open Wearables, the self-hosted platform that unifies all your wearable health data into one clean AI ready API. With
Open Wearables, you hook into one unified API and instantly get normalized health metrics, heart rate, sleep, steps, activity, everything straight
from your users devices. Your infrastructure, your data, zero third party dependencies. Spin it up with a
simple Docker Compose up and you're ready to build.
Metaroid, the open- source pricing and billing engine built for modern SAS. If you're moving to usage based billing or
productled growth, Metoid closes the gap between what customers use and what they actually get build for accurately and in
real time. You plug Meoid into your stack with a simple API. It collects usage data, runs it through your custom
pricing models, and automatically generates precise invoices.
Flowlike, the workflow automation platform that doesn't just show you the steps, it shows you the story behind your data. With Flowlike, you drag,
drop, and build fully typed workflows that are instantly production ready. No handoff, no rewrite, no mystery logic
hiding in a black box. Flowike plugs in LLM, machine learning models, and traditional logic like they're just another building block.
Manifold, your open- source hub for managing 3D models like a pro. Browse your collection in full interactive 3D and find the perfect model instantly.
Categorize everything with tags, metadata, and notes. Track creators, collections, supported formats, and more. Want to share? Keep it private,
make it public, or connect across the Fedverse. Your models, your rules.
Comic Book Collection Manager. The ultimate way to track, organize, and analyze your collection. Digitally log
every comic, title, series, issue, storage location, even signatures. Keep tabs on varants and graphic novels
separately. See your collection like never before with dashboards that track value and trends over time. Find your comics instantly with smart search and advanced filters.
OVPN Manager. Manage OpenVPN servers, users, and resellers, all from one sleek self-hosted web panel. Add users in
bulk, set data and connection limits, track live traffic, and generate OVPN configs instantly. Need subadmins?
Assign quotas and let them manage their own users without touching your main setup. Running multiple servers?
Multi-node support keeps everything synced and under control.
Lumen, the higherformance LLM chat app built for everyone. No more gigabytes of RAM just to idle. No more long waits for
your server to boot. Lumen runs in under 128 megabytes with subsecond cold starts and zero config setup. It's powerful
too. Integrate with open AAI local models or open router. Upload PDFs, generate images, render latte and code,
even do deep research with built-in web search.
Uncloud, the decentralized platform for deploying and managing web apps across cloud VMs and bare metal. It creates a
secure wireguard mesh between your hosts, load balancing and HTTPS ingress.
All with simple Docker compose files. No central control plane, no quorum headaches. Each machine keeps a synced
copy of the cluster state so your apps stay running even if some machines go offline.
